pack.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0 full Core outcomes
pack.jurisdiction: International voluntary use; published by NIST (United States)
pack.source_version: NIST AI 100-1 (2023), with NIST AI 600-1 profile marker
coverage: all 72 subcategory outcomes in the NIST AI RMF 1.0 Core
profile-scoped assessment across GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE
known_gaps: The Playbook actions are guidance and are not encoded as mandatory outcomes.
NIST AI 600-1 is represented by a selection marker; its suggested actions remain a separate profile.
AI RMF 1.0 is under revision and this pinned version must be reviewed when NIST publishes a successor.
Organisation-specific target profiles, tolerances, owners and due dates are not supplied.
pack.notice: NIST AI RMF is voluntary. Findings describe gaps against selected outcomes and do not establish legal non-compliance or certification.

anchors.summary: The voluntary AI RMF Core contains 72 outcomes across GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE.
The Playbook provides optional actions, documentation prompts and references for each Core outcome.
